title: Network Census
story: A new teammate wants to know which network the api uses to reach its cache. The network diagram on the wiki is two reorgs out of date.
objective: Find the network that api and cache share, and finish by displaying that network's inspection.
hints: docker network ls lists the lab's networks.
docker inspect api shows which networks a container is attached to under NetworkSettings.Networks.
docker network inspect cache-net lists every container attached to that network.
explanation: Containers can only talk to each other over a network they share. A network's inspection lists every container attached to it, and a container's inspection lists its networks. Between them you can map who can reach whom without guessing.
